# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 30 Oct 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## Private Home Prices & Resale Market

- **Private home prices rose 1.4% in Q3 2026 — fastest pace in nearly two years** - URA data released 23 Oct shows private residential prices accelerated from 0.5% in Q2 to 1.4% quarter-on-quarter in Q3 2026, even as new launch activity remained subdued. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/singapore-private-home-prices-rise-1-4-in-q3-2026-amid-a-quieter-new-launch-calendar/)

- **Condo resale volumes up 10.8% month-on-month in September 2026** - An estimated 1,093 condo resale units changed hands in September, with prices edging higher, led by stronger performance in the Core Central Region. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-resale-activity-recovers-as-prices-continue-to-rise-in-september-2026/)

- **HDB resale transactions hit a two-year high in Q3 2026, but prices slipped for a third straight quarter** - Resale volumes reached their highest quarterly level since 2024, while prices continued a run of consecutive quarterly declines as more flats traded in the open market. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/hdb-resale-transactions-hit-a-two-year-high-in-q3-2026-as-prices-continue-to-decline/)

## New Launches & Land Supply

- **Orchard Boulevard GLS site sold for $181.9 million; analysts expect launch prices from $3,500 psf** - Hong Leong Holdings and TID topped five bids for the site, paying 8.5% more than the next bidder, with market watchers projecting new homes could be priced from $3,500 psf. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/new-orchard-boulevard-condo-launch/)

- **Two GLS Reserve List sites at Chuan Grove and former Raffles Town Club could add 1,180 homes** - URA has released both sites under the 2H2026 GLS Reserve List, with Chuan Grove alone capable of yielding around 930 units, adding to the private residential pipeline. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/gls-reserve-list-site-chuan-grove-former-raffles-town-club-1180-homes/)

- **Marina South developer paid 12% less per square foot than the adjacent site's winning bid** - EL Development secured the Marina Gardens Lane site at $1,243 psf ppr, compared with the price Kingsford paid for the neighbouring One Marina Gardens plot. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/owners-one-marina-gardens-may-feel/)
